primary_endpoint: Histological improvement and NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: Histological improvement: 6 participants with tropifexor, 9 with licogliflozin, 10 with combination therapy, and 4 with placebo. NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis: 5, 3, 10, and 2 participants, respectively; statistical comparisons were not provided.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 4/53 with tropifexor, 3/55 with licogliflozin, 4/84 with combination therapy, and 3/41 with placebo; no deaths were reported.
